overview: The Medford School Committee approved superintendent evaluation rubrics and subcommittee guidelines, received reports on student incident reporting, integrated mathematics, and dyslexia screening, and passed resolutions regarding high school safety procedures and the FY24 budget timeline.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Superintendent Evaluation Rubric Motions
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, which included motions establishing evaluation indicators for the superintendent and creating a three-member evaluation subcommittee.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the December 6, 2022 subcommittee minutes following a report on revisions to the district's Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan.

items.title: Superintendent Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent highlighted student academic, athletic, and artistic achievements, announced upcoming kindergarten open houses, and noted district Black History Month events.

items.title: Parent Caregiver Incident Notice Form and School Brains Referral Tracking
items.summary: District leaders presented a draft high school incident form and expanded parent access to School Brains referral tracking, leading to discussion on elementary discipline communication and plans for a family training webinar.

items.title: Integrated Mathematics Pathways Pilot Update
items.summary: Director of Mathematics Faiza Khan presented an update on the pilot implementation and multi-year course sequences for the Integrated Mathematics Pathways program at Medford High School.

items.title: Dyslexia Screening and Intervention Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Suzanne Galusi reported on kindergarten through second-grade dyslexia screening using DIBELS and MAP, tiered reading interventions, and upcoming plans to select a new elementary core literacy curriculum.

items.title: Resolution on High School Safety and Discipline Procedures
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution referring new safety and discipline procedures at Medford High School to the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Subcommittee for review.

items.title: Resolution on Superintendent Evaluation Process
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution referring the timeline, instructions, and template development for the superintendent's evaluation to the Superintendent Evaluation Subcommittee.

items.title: Resolution on Fiscal Year 2024 Budget Timeline
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution requesting a proposed process and timeline from the superintendent for the FY24 budget by March 6, 2023.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of former district educators and staff relatives.
